remarks: Stamford Waterside Area 2 Family home - 1st floor - Living Room (accessible from front entrance) opens to spacious Eat-in Kitchen. 3-4 Bedrooms, 4th Bedroom on Lower Level could also be a Family Room and has access to Laundry area (1st Fl washer dryer belongs to the tenant) and has door to backyard. Hallway has linen closet and door to basement. 2nd floor - Good size Living Room with Dining area - also has access to private backyard. 2 Bedrooms with hardwood floor. Laundry Room with washer/dryer hookup accesses Kitchen. Separate electric and gas meters. 2 car detached garage plus off street pkg. Walk to Southfield Beach which has playground, basketball court, 2 tennis courts and marina. Convenient to Stamford Train, I-95 and downtown.
